title: The Field Discovery Window Rhythm
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A step-through vis-timeline of the four-week course that draws each 2-hour live session and each 7-day Field Discovery Window to scale, with a detail panel showing each entry's assignment, Jordan's version of it, and how it connects to the entries before and after it.

prerequisites: Chapter 2: Founder Mindset & the Cohort Learning Experience
educational.topic: Live sessions and Field Discovery Windows in the four-week course
learningObjectives: Explain what happens during each live session and each Field Discovery Window across the four-week course
Describe the relationship between live instruction inside the cohort and real-world testing outside it

controls.label: Previous
controls.purpose: Step back one entry in course order (also the left arrow key)

controls.label: Next
controls.purpose: Step forward one entry in course order (also the right arrow key)

controls.label: Session and FDW blocks
controls.purpose: Click to jump to an entry; hover for a one-line preview

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Step-through timeline with concrete detail for each step, no animation
keyQuestions: What does each live session produce, and what does each Field Discovery Window test?
Why is there a full week of field work between every pair of live sessions?
commonMisconceptions: The live sessions are where most of the course's work happens
The time between sessions is a break rather than an assignment
assessmentOpportunities: State the assignment for any session or window without looking
Explain what one window takes from the session before it and hands to the session after it
